description: Cancellation of a request that is still running. The settings block sets debug_stall_ms, which delays a search before it scans purely so this exchange can be recorded deterministically against a real process; it has no place in real configuration. The cancel notification carries no id of its own and expects no reply, so a replayer must send it without waiting for the search it abandons — that is the whole reason the lockstep rule exempts notifications. The adapter notices the cancelled context and returns, and the server renders the context error as budget_exceeded (-32006). It never answers with an empty successful search, which would be indistinguishable from a stream holding no matching events.
